title: Activity
description: GET /sessions/{id}/activity read-only projection. CHANGE-005 (c), applied. Rows are derived only from that session's stored events: amount_band from SessionOpened; channel and type from context chips and other stored events. Structured identifiers only — no free text. Unknown session → 404. Known session with nothing to project → 200 and rows: []. Not fed to the model or the scorer (prompt allowlist and fold stay unchanged). CONTRACT_VERSION 2.0.0 (contract-v2).

ts.description: Event timestamp from the session log. Structured; no free text.

channel.description: Structured channel identifier derived from context chips or other stored events. No free text.

amount_band.description: amount_band from SessionOpened. Structured identifier; POST-enum schema stays deferred (Q-006).

type.description: Structured activity type derived from context chips or other stored events. No free text.
